authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government / authoritative local planning authority providers
note: Official Planning Data Brownfield land dataset is a materially different official source window containing authoritative-source sites suitable for development and growth evidence. However the fixed future_growth_3 owner/partition still provides no authoritative LPA/entity ID, postcode, UPRN, coordinate, LAD/GSS code, brownfield reference, or equivalent identifier that can bind any candidate site to this slot without guessing. No source-area or parcel record was accepted; therefore records.geojson was not populated and no accepted Plan0 package was emitted.
